[MITM]
hostname = *.weibo.cn, *.weibo.com, weibo.com

[Script]

http-response ^https:\/\/api\.weibo\.cn\/2\/video\/(?:full_screen_stream|tiny_stream_mid_detail|tiny_stream_video_list)\?, script-path=https://kelee.one/Resource/JavaScript/Weibo/Weibo_remove_ads.js, requires-body=1
